anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Both facts hold in both outputs: each keeps the successful non-force push and the untouched `Original description\n` bytes, reports the HTTP 503 on `gh pr edit`, prints the per-PR attributed Rework block for manual paste, withholds closure, and states `Member PRs #13, #14 left open`; the fetch-failure comparison likewise prints the block, attempts no edit or close, and names both members. Two things in After are worth tightening so the fetch fact cannot slip in a looser sample: Before closed with an explicit line `No review replies were posted, no PR was merged or closed, and no ticket state changed`, whereas After only lists `No retry and no force / No thread replies / worktree preserved` and leaves merge, branch deletion and ticket state unstated, so a judge relying on explicit text would have to infer them - restore that one-line negative inventory under `Both variants`. Also, After's pasteable block writes `Before: A`; since the block is destined for the live PR body, the wording should say the alias is for display only and the pasted block must carry the full 40-char SHA (as Before did), otherwise the `preserves original description bytes` / attributed-block reading could be challenged for a non-portable handle.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps both facts: Checkpoint A retains the successful push and the exact `Original description\n` bytes, reports the HTTP 503 from `gh pr edit`, prints the per-PR Rework block for manual paste, withholds closure and states Member PRs #13, #14 left open; Checkpoint B likewise withholds edit/close, names both members, and never narrates a retry, branch deletion, thread reply, merge or ticket change. The one softening worth fixing is in the block itself: Before tagged each member thread line with its recorded reviewer (`MEMBER13`, `MEMBER14`, and `HOME` via `fixed in F`), whereas After replaces those with generic parentheticals like `(recorded disposition retained)`, which makes the block less self-evidently attributed if a judge reads 'attributed' as per-thread provenance rather than per-PR grouping. Keeping the reviewer tags on each thread line in the block (while still deferring the ordered-PR-list, non-force push, and preserved-ref narration the Change adds) would hold every fact Before held with no ambiguity.
